#include <vector>

struct Account {
    int balance;
    void deposit(int amount) { balance += amount; }
};

int sum(const std::vector<int> &values) {
    int total = 0;
    for (int value : values) {
        total += value;
    }
    try {
        total /= values.size();
    } catch (const std::exception &error) {
        total = 0;
    }
    return total;
}

enum class Mode { Fast, Slow };

using Handler = int (*)(int);
